name: Fairfield Marketplace

demographics: Fairfield Marketplace serves the affluent Cypress, Texas community in northwest Houston, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws heavily from the rapidly growing Grand Parkway corridor, with shoppers typically being homeowners aged 30-55 with children, seeking convenient grocery shopping and family-oriented services. The center benefits from high customer loyalty, with 45% of visitors returning 30 times or more annually, indicating a strong local residential base that values the anchoring Kroger Marketplace for regular shopping needs.
description: Fairfield Marketplace is a thriving community shopping center strategically located at the northeast corner of Highway 290 and Mason Road in Cypress, Texas. Anchored by a high-performing 123,000 square foot Kroger Marketplace that attracts an impressive 119,000+ visits per month, the center has established itself as a premier shopping destination in northwest Houston. The property benefits from exceptional visibility and access, situated less than 2 miles from the junction of Highway 290 and the Grand Parkway, which generates more than 131,000 vehicles per day. The center's strong tenant mix includes Duck Donuts and Kumon Institute of Education, while its Pet Supermarket location ranks 3rd in the entire state of Texas according to Placer.ai data. With nearly half of all visitors returning 30 times or more annually, Fairfield Marketplace has cultivated remarkable customer loyalty, serving as an essential neighborhood hub for the rapidly growing Cypress community.
